transcript.content: Hello, welcome in. What brings you into the clinic today?
My doctor says I’ve gotten too thin. My work pants are hanging loose on me now. I know that probably isn’t good, but… when I see a lower number on the scale, part of me still feels relieved.
Do you feel an intense fear of gaining weight or becoming fat?
Yes. If I eat something heavier, like biscuits or pasta, I worry the rest of the day that it’s going to show on me. I keep checking myself and thinking I need to make up for it.
Is your current weight considered significantly below normal for your height?
I think so, yes. My doctor says I’m too thin, and my work pants are hanging loose now. I know that’s probably not normal, but seeing the scale go down still makes me feel relieved.
If you menstruate, have your periods stopped or become irregular since losing weight?
I’m not sure—I don’t really know what would count as irregular.
When was the last time you had a menstrual period?
I’m not sure, honestly. I haven’t been keeping track of it.
Did you intentionally lose this weight by restricting how much you eat?
Yes. I make meals for my husband and mother-in-law, but when it’s time for me to eat, I usually just have coffee, a few vegetables, or maybe half a piece of toast. I tell myself that’s enough.
Even though you are underweight, do you still see yourself as fat or feel that parts of your body are too large?
I mean, when I’m small and neat, I feel like I’m doing things right. But if I look in the mirror and my stomach looks even a little full, I feel like I’ve let myself go.
Have you had any menstrual bleeding at all in the past three months?
I’m not sure. I haven’t really noticed or kept track of any bleeding.
Could you tell me your current height and weight?
I don’t know my exact height and weight offhand. My doctor says I’ve gotten too thin, and my work pants are hanging loose on me. But… I still feel relieved when the number on the scale goes down.
Did your doctor tell you what your Body Mass Index, or BMI, is?
I don’t remember him giving me a BMI number. He just said I’d gotten too thin, and my work pants are hanging loose. But I still feel relieved when the scale number is lower.
Do you exercise excessively or feel driven to work out to control your weight?
I’m not sure what you mean by excessive. I do try to stay active, but I haven’t really kept track of how much I work out.
Do you ever make yourself vomit after eating to prevent weight gain?
I’m not sure… I don’t really know what you mean by making myself vomit after eating.
Do you ever use laxatives or water pills to help manage your weight?
I’m not really sure what you mean by water pills. I haven’t noticed myself using anything like that to manage my weight.
Are you currently taking birth control pills or any other hormone medications?
I don’t think so. I’m not aware of taking any birth control or hormone medicine.
Do you take any diet pills or medications to suppress your appetite?
No, I don’t take diet pills or anything to suppress my appetite.
Have you gone through menopause?
I’m not sure. What exactly do you mean by menopause?
How old are you?
